category.name: Glass & Optics
category.description: Fluted, reeded, block, frosted, pebbled, cathedral, wired and tinted architectural glazing.

materials.name: Fluted Reeded Glass
materials.description: Architectural vertical fluted/reeded privacy glass ribs. Optically ribbed privacy glass with refractive flutes.

projection.tiling_note: Flutes run along V; keep them vertical. Use MeshPhysicalMaterial.transmission with the albedo as attenuation tint.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 0.3 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 0.3 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Glass picks up water spots and dust in flute valleys.

materials.name: Frosted Prism Diffuser
materials.description: Ceiling prismatic acrylic light-diffuser panel with micro-pyramids. Acid-etched, sandblasted and opal glass with diffusing micro-relief.

projection.tiling_note: Frosting is isotropic; triplanar is fine. Pair high roughness with transmission for diffusion.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 0.3 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 0.3 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Frosted glass hides dirt; keep weathering subtle.
